experimental_question: Repeat adaptive population comparisons at 10 s and 60 s, excluding 1 s cases whose FIFO mapping is invalid, and retain the valid controlled timing and static gateway checks.

design.tag_positions: All tags and trajectory epochs are co-located at [120, 200, 10.78] m, the existing single-tag receive-smoke location. This is an artificial controlled topology, not a farm deployment model.
design.localization_claim: Input availability only. The control geometry is designed to isolate contention, not optimize anchor geometry.

schedule_support.SOURCE_TIMESTAMP: Exact common source times; synchronized burst.
schedule_support.SEEDED_PHASE: FREQUENCIA's seeded per-device phase within the cadence, reused at every epoch.
schedule_support.NEAR_SYNCHRONIZED: FREQUENCIA's seeded per-device phase within 10 ms, reused at every epoch.
schedule_support.not_supported: Per-packet jitter and bursty schedules are not representable in the current Simulation Contract: every tag must have trajectory samples at the same timestamp set. Do not relabel SEEDED_PHASE as per-packet randomization.

design.requested_vs_effective: The request, generated FREQUENCIA config and trajectory hashes, run manifest parameter binding, ns-3 event schedule, and actual TX start timestamps are retained per execution.
design.duration_note: Ten TX epochs per tag provide more repeated evidence than the original three-epoch campaign. Seeds vary deterministic device phases; they do not randomize RF geometry.

interpretation.collision_attribution: Only modeled gateway PHY INTERFERENCE outcomes support interference attribution. NO_PATH, UNDER_SENSITIVITY, NO_DEMODULATOR, NOT_TRANSMITTED, UNTRACED_DROP and UNKNOWN remain distinct.
interpretation.capacity: Conditional on this co-located synthetic geometry, four gateways, cadence, payload, SF, traffic schedule and ns-3 assumptions. Not a product/field animal capacity statement.
interpretation.duty_cycle: NOT_MODELED in the effective adapter config: the simulator supports duty-cycle enforcement, but this adapter configures the synthetic sub-band at 100% duty.
interpretation.gateway_failure: Only static omission can be tested by comparing the first three configured gateways with all four. A temporal offline/degraded/recovery state is not modeled.
interpretation.application_delivery: NOT_MODELED: terminal metric is gateway PHY reception.
interpretation.invalidated_evidence: The initial closure ledger has 1-second schedule cases. Exclude those cases from interpretation because ns-3 TxStart FIFO associates delayed transmissions with the wrong source packet/event identity; see C.1 results.
